headline: Tate Taylor helps USA set world U20 4x100m record
summary: The American quartet set a new under-20 world mark in Oregon.
script: Tate Taylor helped the United States set a world under-twenty 4-by-100-metre record in Oregon. It is a landmark sprint result for the American junior team at the World Athletics championships.
